notes: Child-specific notices (slice 2). The listener check names the child and nothing else; everything specific is said only after the parent presses 1.
Darjeeling register, not Kathmandu office Nepali: तपाईं with -नुहुन्छ forms (gender-neutral), थिच्नुहोस् for press, keys as words (एक, दुई, नौ).

Every sentence must pass the per-sentence Nepali gate (src/lib/sampark/scripts/purity.ts): no Hindi-only word, no nukta, at least one Nepali marker. That is why "धन्यवाद" is joined to the next clause with a comma.
Postpositions attach to a slot with no space ({childName}को, {date}सम्म, {schoolName}बाट).
A1, A3 and A4 share one wording on purpose, and none states a concern.
